kind: CPU source review and explicit collision/navigation models; no browser or GPU
limits: CPU models are not GPU execution or ordinary-input gameplay.
Actor collision uses the game quarter-metre static grid and half-metre dynamic raster with the .24 m actor footprint.
Squad search mirrors the bounded 256-node/192-expansion algorithm, but does not simulate steering, crowd avoidance, doors auto-opening or concurrent moving actors.
Breach probes establish geometry clearance only, not actual damage/fracture behavior.
